FAQ

Questions people ask before they verify.

Does it work with large servers?

Yes. VeriBot is built to handle high-volume joins and can scale with your moderation workflow.

Can I add custom welcome channels?

Absolutely. You can configure messages, welcome channels, and automatically assigned roles.

Is there a free trial?

Yes. You can try the core verification features before upgrading to Pro or Enterprise.
